subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like a friendly salesman explaining a payment plan: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, the head nods a little with each point; one hand leaves the other, rises in front of the chest with the back of the hand to the camera and counts on its fingers: one finger up, then two fingers up, then three fingers up; then settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
